ownership.runtime_run_id: Use the actual platform run ID when exposed; otherwise null plus reason. A locally generated execution_instance_id is not a runtime run ID.
ownership.before_each_write_and_create: Fresh-read route and lock; require matching active_automation_id and route_generation, exact holder and acquired_at, unexpired lease, and own item claim. Any mismatch stops the write/Create. A held generic chatgpt lock is foreign.
ownership.expired_lease: Reacquire only when allowed; expiry never clears a claim or proves that Create did not happen.
ownership.release: Release only the exact lease this execution acquired; do not release a replacement lease, even if expired.

chat_replacement.ordinary_chat_switch: Do not create another schedule merely because the owner opens a new working conversation. Read this stable role record and peek active_automation_id; the existing schedule and GitHub state remain the source of continuity.
explicit_executor_replacement: Read fresh main and all existing tasks; do not guess a target conversation or change the primary route.
Prepare a replacement ordinary-chat task with submissions disabled until accepted. Verify its actual ID/settings and a read-only runtime result.
Under the canon lock, CAS-update active_automation_id and increment route_generation; preserve prior route and evidence in history. Existing claims and retry budgets are not reset.
Every old/new worker rechecks the active route immediately before claim/Create. The old route becomes read-only as soon as the pointer changes.
Pause the old backup task after verified switch; retain its history. Never move a task to an arbitrary conversation through an unsupported API field.
